summary: Frontend testing for numbered category layout (01-10) on Premium mobile and Free Preview. All acceptance criteria PASS. Premium mobile /sample-report at 390px renders premium-mobile-categories with 01 Player Snapshot open + 02-10 CatRow accordion (single-open behaviour confirmed: opening pm-cat-iq closes pm-cat-tech), sticky pm-tabs, evidence tab jumps and opens pm-cat-evidence, proof buttons open bottom sheet with '00:58' clip, score chips 8.0/7.7/7.5, count chips 6/18/4, no horizontal overflow (390==390), no console errors. Desktop 1440px keeps original grid (v2-player-hero-card, v2-parent-summary-card, v2-overall-score-card all present), premium-mobile-categories NOT in DOM. Free Preview at 390px on /report/testfree-cat-layout-1: fpl-snapshot-card (Noah Jensen · Winger · 78 POTENTIAL STRONG), fpl-free-proof (BIGGEST STRENGTH / 1 OF 4 OPEN / 00:26), all 9 locked category rows fpl-cat-iq..verdict, fpl-proof-open opens proof sheet with 'PROOF · 00:26' + 'MOMENT AT 00:26' + 'Playing from 00:22'; clicking fpl-cat-development scrolls to #scout-packages (packages in viewport); fpl-cat-evidence opens LOCKED proof teaser sheet ('Unlocks with the full report'); fpl-unlock-btn and fpl-sticky-cta-btn both scroll to packages; sticky bar at y=718 above the 62px tab bar (mobile 844 viewport); gift pill share-gift-pill at y=671 above sticky and opens ShareUnlockModal ('SHARE NOAH'S CARD - UNLOCK ONE MORE STORY' with WhatsApp/Facebook/Copy/Story options). Desktop 1280 FPL renders, no overflow, sticky CTA hidden (md:hidden). PDF bar tested via seeded unlocked report testpaid-cat-layout-1: pm-pdf-bar sticky at bottom above tab bar (top 718, bottom 782), pm-pdf-btn triggers GET /api/reports/{id}/pdf which returns 200 with 2.5MB application/pdf (after fixing parent_summary shape in seed). No console errors on either page.
critical_code_review_comments: categories.jsx line 123: category body is conditionally mounted (open && <div>) rather than kept mounted+hidden — this means transitions can't animate and headless tests using is_visible on a body testid won't work. Consider always-mounted with max-height transition, or add pm-cat-{key}-body data-testid on the open state div for easier automation.
PremiumReportV2.jsx exposes onDownloadPdf only on /report/:id (ReportPage). Good — sample-report has no PDF bar. Nothing to change.

PDF endpoint /api/reports/{id}/pdf crashes with 500 (AttributeError in pdf_v2.derive_v2 line 350) when parent_summary is a plain string. Not this iter's regression but a fragility — consider isinstance guard on parent_summary shape in pdf_v2.py.
